name: A-l26-edit-s301
prompt: <image1> shows a creature at its young stage. Draw the same creature grown into its adult stage. Body change: make it a powerful adult: a much bigger, longer body with a broad deep chest, thick strong legs in a confident striding pose, a soft leaf-green mossy mane now covers the neck and shoulders, and a long bushy tail sweeps back. Keep from <image1>: the face with its eyes, small mouth and coral cheeks, wide rounded leaf-shaped ears that hang slightly sideways, and a cream blaze running from the nose up over the forehead, the apricot and cream colors and the flat two-tone style without outlines. One creature, full body, three-quarter front view, plain flat pale mint background.
